verification.note: I read addons/intelligence/tests/test_llm_caller_inventory.py in full (126 lines). It has no reference to generate_stream, generate_stream_with_image or vision. Its five tests cover only client construction, resolve_without_ceiling, reads of settings.llm, imports of the client types, and imports of evals or resolver internals. generate_stream_with_image exists only in app/llm.py and app/routers/rag.py, so no test checks the new streaming-with-image caller. The file is a declared touch point and was not changed. The claim that it should register the new call is a judgement about the spec. The factual part holds. The impact is a missing guard test, not a runtime defect.

AnswerMarkdown.tsx:185-209: withoutImagesAndRefusedLinks detects fences only with /^ {0,3}(`{3,}|~{3,})/ (line 191) and does not treat 4-space indented code as code. A fence inside a blockquote ('> ```') or a list item indented 4 or more spaces is also missed. For those lines stripInlineMarkup runs (line 206), so an image inside them becomes its alt text and a refused link becomes its label. The effect is limited to code shown with altered text. The change errs toward not fetching images, so it does not open a security hole. It does depart from I10's rule that code is rendered literally.
